metadata.generated_by: tools/parity_monitor.py (v2: multi-draw averaged, see module docstring)
metadata.silo_deviation: mean over 3 independent GradientExplainer draws of [1 - Jaccard@10(silo top-10, leave-one-out consensus of other eligible silos IN THE SAME DRAW)] -- consensus never mixes feature indices across draws
metadata.threshold_method: modified z-score (median/MAD) on the draw-averaged deviation, per (tag, round), flagged if z > 3.5 (Iglewicz & Hoaglin 1993)
metadata.why_averaged: single-draw version flagged 2 silos (fedavg_a0.1_s1337 round 5) that did not reproduce under independent re-explanation -- traced to single-draw MAD collapse from coarse top-k vote ties; see tools/parity_noise_floor.py and module docstring 'v2' section

limitation: Zero flags at alpha=0.1 does not mean alpha=0.1 is healthy: the modified-z threshold is relative to each fleet's own spread that round. Flags rely on multi-draw averaging (N>=3).
